answer: An farming party running 10 aliases as a result needs 109 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are entered in garden, expire in vertex, and summit lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 28 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1863 identities would post 2609 proofs and burn roughly 17 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
